I confirmed via `arena_query` that S02's day_1_5 "October peak" was actually a 6+ week plateau (doy260–302, mostly 1.3–5.0+ ypa), that this season's Fridays (doy245/252/.../301, derived from my own journal's weekday entries) land right inside that plateau with strong results (1.65–5.0 ypa) — so the weekends-only/no-PTO persona isn't structurally shut out of it — and that three_quarter, which looked like a decent secondary early in the ramp, went flat to 0.000 for most of the actual peak window. I also corrected an earlier note that mis-extrapolated ONI's trend (it plateaued around -0.34 to -0.5 rather than continuing to warm).

Updated `notes.md` with these three findings and a consolidated S03 plan (pace budget to keep $1650+ in reserve for a confirmed autumn day_1_5 run, target Friday departures once it's hot, stop treating 3Q as a peak-window hedge). Skipped the forum post this turn — the findings are specific enough to my own no-PTO playbook that sharing them mainly hands competitors edge with no offsetting benefit, since S02 doesn't count and S03 will need its own live confirmation anyway.
